evidence: Official manual for Cycles, Blender's unbiased path-tracing render engine with CPU/GPU support (CUDA, HIP, Metal, oneAPI).
Official Cycles X announcement: full architecture rewrite of Cycles on its 10th anniversary, targeting faster GPU rendering and viewport interactivity.
Blender 4.2 LTS release notes shipping EEVEE Next: rewritten real-time engine with screen-space ray tracing, virtual shadow maps and displacement.
Blender 4.5 LTS notes: full Vulkan backend support, faster EEVEE shader compilation and startup; LTS maintained until July 2027.
Official crowdsourced hardware benchmark platform: CPU/GPU Cycles render scores submitted by users across all Blender versions.
Published benchmark comparing RTX 40-series GPU rendering in Blender 3.4 Cycles against RTX 30-series and Radeon RX 7900 XTX.
BlenderProc paper: modular procedural pipeline built on Blender/Cycles that renders photorealistic images reducing the sim2real gap for vision training.
Official Grease Pencil manual: 2D animation and drawing inside Blender's 3D pipeline with draw, sculpt, edit and vertex paint modes.
Announcement of Grease Pencil 3.0 full rewrite on the new curves backend: multi-threaded, Geometry Nodes-compatible, designed for the next decade.
Blender 4.3 release notes: GPv3 ships as default with layer groups, Geometry Nodes support and automatic file conversion from older versions.
Official Line Art documentation: generates stylized contour strokes (silhouette, crease, intersection, contour) from scene geometry via Grease Pencil.
Studio postmortem on Wing It!: achieving 2D cartoon appeal in EEVEE via maxed subsurface scattering, toon shading and custom line add-ons.
Hero open movie project page: first Blender Open Movie made entirely with Grease Pencil, showcasing 2D animation inside a 3D pipeline for Blender 2.8.
Malt: MIT-licensed real-time NPR rendering framework for Blender with customizable GLSL pipelines and automatic node generation for stylized rendering.
Official Geometry Nodes manual: node-based procedural geometry modification, instancing, simulation zones and repeat zones.
Sverchok: GPL parametric node-based geometry programming addon for Blender with 500+ nodes for generative modeling.
Animation Nodes: node-based motion-design/procedural animation addon; original repo by Jacques Lucke with community forks maintaining newer Blender versions.
Sorcar: free open-source procedural modeling addon giving node-based non-destructive modeling workflows in Blender.
BlenderProc repo (GPLv3): procedural pipeline generating photorealistic training images with segmentation, depth, normal and pose ground truth via Blender.
Peer-reviewed BlenderProc2 paper describing the procedural photorealistic rendering pipeline built on Blender for synthetic CV datasets.
Sprite Fright production log #32: production use of Geo Nodes for moss scattering plus character grooming and fire simulation reports.
80.lv feature on IRCSS's procedural cathedral: a Geometry Nodes setup containing ~40,000 nodes with reusable node trees, shared publicly.
Official Nonlinear Animation editor docs: reusable Actions organized into tracks/strips with blending, transitions and strip modifiers.
Official Rigify docs: bundled addon generating full character rigs from meta-rigs, with rig types, metarigs and feature-set extensions.
Animation & Rigging module workshop outcomes: MVP scope for layered Actions, named, reorderable, solo-able animation layers in Blender.
Official Animation & Rigging module roadmap: layered Actions in progress (#154504), animation-level constraints and future rig-nodes system like UE Control Rig.
Official interview with Flow director Gints Zilbalodis: Oscar-winning feature made entirely in Blender, EEVEE-rendered at 0.5-10s per 4K frame on a single PC.
Official sculpting documentation: brush system, dynamic topology, multiresolution, remeshing and auto-masking for character work.
Official retopology workflow docs: BSurfaces/Poly Build and shrinkwrap-based techniques to convert sculpts into animation-ready meshes.
Blender 3.3 LTS release notes: new curves-based hair grooming system with sculpt-mode brushes, replacing the legacy particle hair pipeline.
Sprite Fright production log #29: Rex's hair grooming passes, character retopology notes and integration of grooming files into the character pipeline.
Gscatter by Graswald: free Geometry Nodes-powered scattering addon with effect layers, masks, wind and environment presets for nature scenes.
80.lv coverage of Jesse Miettinen's procedural Finland-inspired swamp biome built with Geometry Nodes plus Geo-Scatter vegetation assets.
Modular Tree (Mtree): open-source Blender addon generating parametric trees (trunk, branches, leaves) via a dedicated node editor.
BlenderGIS: GPL addon importing georeferenced data (DEM elevation, satellite imagery, OpenStreetMap) to build real-world terrain environments.
Infinigen CVPR 2023 paper: fully procedural generator of photorealistic natural worlds (terrain, plants, weather) built entirely on Blender.
Infinigen repo (BSD-3): open-source procedural scene generators transpiled to Blender node graphs for unlimited CV training data.
BlenderNation article 'The Key to Realistic Environments in Blender': scattering, clustering and motion principles demonstrated with free GScatter addon.
